note: Official questions mapped to FM Chapter 7 (Investment Decisions). Primary code first. RTP assignment follows ICAI's own topic labels ('Investment Decision', 'Investment Decisions', 'Capital Budgeting Decision'); past papers and MTPs follow the appraisal technique the question computes. Case-scenario MCQ sets are recorded as one atom, using the first MCQ's id, in the same way as RTP-S26-FQ1 in atoms_F04.json. Where ICAI's published text does not print a mark allocation, marks is null.
